chapter: Bay St. Louis roots and early music
title: Schooling in Virginia and switching from violin to clarinet
summary: Labat took lessons at school in Rock Castle, Virginia, played violin, later resumed clarinet; he studied tailoring.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: You just started playing yourself? No, I, I taken a few lessons in school out in Virginia, you see. Wow. And when I came, I used to play a violin. But, uh, after the clarinet, I played a guy in our band. I resumed the clarinet, you see. Uh-huh. And I put the violin down. Oh, yeah. What was this, Virginia? I went to school out in Virginia. Where is this? Rock Castle, Virginia. About 40 miles from Richmond.
